sources.title: Pure de Sitter Supergravity

evidence.text: Can one construct a complete scalar-free component supergravity action and transformation rules coupling the nonlinear Volkov–Akulov Goldstino to gravity, with spontaneously broken local supersymmetry and a de Sitter bosonic solution?

sources.title: Brane induced supersymmetry breaking and de Sitter supergravity

evidence.text: Can a space-filling goldstino brane provide a geometric formulation of spontaneously broken N=1, D=4 supergravity admitting de Sitter vacua, and how does this formulation relate to constrained superfields?

sources.title: Goldstino superfields in $ \mathcal{N}=2 $ supergravity

evidence.text: How can constrained Goldstino superfields be coupled to off-shell N=2 supergravity and matter to describe spontaneously broken local supersymmetry, including parameter ranges admitting de Sitter vacua?

sources.title: Stückelberg path to pure de Sitter supergravity

evidence.text: Can the perturbative super-Stückelberg construction of unimodular supergravity be completed to all orders in its compensating fields, restoring full diffeomorphism and local supersymmetry invariance while retaining spontaneously supersymmetry-breaking de Sitter solutions?

sources.title: Pure de Sitter Supergravity

evidence.text: F⁰ and Aμ are eliminated by Gaussian algebraic equations. Goldstino auxiliary F requires non-Gaussian elimination because substituting X=χ²/(2F) introduces inverse powers of F; Grassmann nilpotency permits a terminating closed expression.

sources.title: Brane induced supersymmetry breaking and de Sitter supergravity

evidence.text: Track auxiliary-field dependence through the vielbein expansion. After integration by parts, the brane action contains auxiliaries only linearly or quadratically without derivatives, permitting linear algebraic equations and standard Gaussian elimination.

sources.title: Goldstino superfields in $ \mathcal{N}=2 $ supergravity

evidence.text: Nonlinear supersymmetry cosets, differential nilpotency constraints and composite-superfield identities relate spinor, chiral scalar and analytic Goldstino realizations. Descendants reconstruct constrained scalar superfields from Goldstini and their auxiliary component.

sources.title: Stückelberg path to pure de Sitter supergravity

evidence.text: Superspace changes of variables, Berezinians, and integration by parts establish invariance of the dressed action. An alternative derivation requires dressed supercoordinates Y^M=e^(−δϕ)Z^M to transform as chiral superfields.

sources.title: Pure de Sitter Supergravity

evidence.text: The gravitino analysis uses gamma-matrix and Ricci identities on Euclidean S⁴, followed by an integrated nonnegative expression for a putative zero mode. Lorentzian invertibility is then asserted through analytic continuation.

sources.title: Pure de Sitter Supergravity

evidence.text: Superconformal component calculus preserves manifest linear off-shell supersymmetry before imposing the constraint. The compensator gauge X⁰=bar X⁰=√3/κ and χ⁰=0 fixes local Weyl, R and special supersymmetry.

sources.title: Unimodular vs Nilpotent Superfield Approach to Pure dS Supergravity

evidence.text: Does super-unimodular gravity yield the same pure de Sitter supergravity action as the goldstino-brane/nilpotent-superfield constructions? The paper tests this through cubic order as a step toward understanding possible uniqueness.

sources.title: Anti-brane uplift instability from goldstino condensation

evidence.text: Can goldstino self-interactions generate composite states whose dynamics destabilize the Volkov–Akulov vacuum and the de Sitter critical points obtained from its supergravity and KKLT embeddings?

sources.title: Properties of Nilpotent Supergravity

evidence.text: Can nonlinear supersymmetry and the goldstino arise from a constrained gravitational multiplet, and what restrictions does that gravitational origin impose on matter couplings and inflationary models?

sources.title: Goldstino condensation?

evidence.text: Does the unstable two-unconstrained-superfield model proposed for goldstino condensation continuously approach Volkov–Akulov theory, de Sitter supergravity, or KKLT, thereby establishing an instability in those theories?

sources.title: Non-linear realisations in global and local supersymmetry

evidence.text: How can constrained superfields systematically describe four-dimensional effective theories with spontaneously broken global or local supersymmetry, chosen light spectra and applications to supergravity and de Sitter uplift?

sources.title: Cosmology with Nilpotent Superfields

evidence.text: Can replacing the goldstino chiral multiplet by a nilpotent multiplet simplify supergravity inflation and vacuum uplifting, remove sgoldstino stabilization, and connect these constructions to Volkov–Akulov goldstinos on super-Dp-branes?
